analysis: admission explicitly scoped to tested workload/hardware; stricter production CI/release not implied
authorization_to_start: after independent build pair and exactness checks; lead approves material component signal and grants exclusive timing window; otherwise leave timing unrun. Preserve first failure.
control: Legacy default scalar; active cohort 16 notes, not instrumented active-voice count
correctness: full matched history PCM across six segments, 3 policies, finite/nonzero and source protocol guards. Independent stock/candidate reports for post-A serialized state, parameters and workload protocol, in addition to component, host tests and audio comparison. No claim every state/DAW/sample rate matches.
platform: local GNU14.2 Debian13 Linux x86-64; actual VST3 with retained vetted diagnostic host. Not DAW or cross-platform measurement.
primary: Circuit, fixed known steady 16-note held workload (48 kHz block 64 realtime)
promotion_metric: Circuit lower end of 95% whole-block bootstrap gain must exceed max absolute A/A gain and 3x maximum overhead fraction; require Pure/Legacy lower ends >= -3%, not merely no significant regression. No data-dependent switch to another target or partial effect after a failed/uncertain gate.
schedule: Unmodified retained timing driver, identical source-derived encoded protocol. 2 stock A/A blocks then 6 ABBA per mode, 4 slots each, fresh processes, warmup 65536, measured 524288 (8192 callbacks). Steady thread CPU only inside plugin. No automatic retries or dropped/replacements; 25s wall cap per slot, 24s worker deadline, 1GiB evidence cap.
treatment: in-place retained Nodes endpoint, const reference to preadvance endpoint; no floating-point arithmetic change intended
